item.title: Los Angeles: Anti-Israel shirt sparks clash outside LA kosher bakery

item.title: Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and the holiday of Sukkot in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Sunday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat and Sukkot at 19:07 Jerusalem time.
Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!
